messages:
Elena: Quick sync — putting up a proposed deprecation window for older models in the catalog. Need input on launch gates and customer impact. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-424 :eyes:
Samir: Can you outline the rollback and quality gates? we should be explicit about perf/latency/regen failures thresholds before we flip traffic.
Maria: Draft proposal in the doc. My suggestion: 30d soft-deprecate (warning banners), 60d hard-deprecate (no new pins), 90d retire if no active pins. Launch gates: automated evals pass, <1% generation regressions on baseline, latency within 10% of current.
Jason: Runtime concerns — we need a compatibility shim for model family id changes. Otherwise customer SDKs that pin by name break. I'm proposing a compatibility alias layer + default fallback to a pinned artifact. Example rollout policy snippet:```json
{
  "rule": "canary",
  "canary_percent": 10,
  "monitoring_window_minutes": 60,
  "fallback": "previous-stable"
}
```
Jason: Also recommend an automated smoke test that runs a representative prompt set during canary.
Arjun: From CS — customers hate surprise swaps. Can we offer a "customer freeze" option (60d opt-in) where we won't auto-migrate pinned routes? Some enterprise customers require that.
Maria: Yes — proposing a pin-exemption flag on the catalog entry with TTL and owner/contact. It should be visible in Console and surfaced to onboarding checklists.
Samir: For metrics, make them signal-based: perf latency p95, cost per token change, and a semantic-similarity regression metric (embedding + answer-match). If any signal crosses threshold, canary should auto-roll back. Need to specify thresholds.
Elena: Draft thresholds: p95 latency delta >15% OR semantic-regression >2% OR cost increase >12% => fail. Are those reasonable?
Samir: +1 for conservative numbers as default, we can tighten later. Also need a path for partial rollbacks by region/model variant.
Jason: Implementation note: routing policy should allow routing by policy priority (latency, cost, region) and include a graceful fallback route to hosted small instance for degraded cases.
Maria: Launch criteria checklist (short):
- all automated evals green on benchmark suite
- Console warnings show up for soft-deprecations
- Pin-exemption flow implemented and documented
- Compatibility aliasing enabled in runtime
- Canary rollback automation wired to metrics
- Customer comms + CS playbook ready
Elena: Scope negotiation: can we cut the initial rollout to hosted API only for 1.0, and defer Dedicated/Private integration to 1.1? That reduces runtime changes needed.
Jason: Agree for 1.0 hosted-only. Dedicated/Private require KMS and local alias mapping work. Mark as 1.1.
Arjun: We'll draft customer comms templates. Need product approval to include migration assistance as a paid hook.
Maria: Will add that to the PRD, and create a short support-runbook (CS + SE steps).
ProductOpsBot: Created INF-512: "catalog-deprecation-rollout-plan" and linked INF-424. Assigned to Maria, Jason, and Samir.
Elena: Next steps: Maria to update PRD with thresholds and pin-exemption UX by EOD Thursday; Jason to prototype alias layer; Samir to define vetting evals. Friday 30m sync to finalize gates.
Samir: noted.
Jason: sending a quick spike PR in the morning. :thumbsup:
Arjun: I'll start drafting the customer email + FAQ.
Maria: thanks all — aiming for clear migration windows and minimal surprise for customers. :shipit:
Elena: Awesome. If anyone has blockers, ping me.
